messages:
nina: Quick note  CI linkcheck failing for one Windows-built artifact: anchors like `#deep-linking` on /guides/windows show 404s.
owen: Can you paste the error?
nina: Linkcheck line: `ERROR: 404 https://staging.redwood/guides/windows/#deep-linking` but the source link in guides/intro.md points to `/guides/windows/#Deep-Linking` (capital D and mixed case).
paul: Ah, case-sensitivity mismatch on the static host. mac/linux builds were case-insensitive in dev so this slipped by. We should canonicalize anchors to lower-case during slug generation.
link-bot: Suggested action: add `slugify(...).lower()` in pipeline and run `tools/regen-anchors --apply` after merge.
owen: Small PR ready: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pull/1301  lowers anchors during generation and adds a test for Windows-hosted case sensitivity.
nina: Please also add a short note to CONTRIBUTING.md: "Headings are normalized to lower-case; run regen tool if you rename headings."
paul: Merged and kicked nightly. linkcheck green on staging. Created ticket DOCS-900 to sweep oddcase headings.
nina: Thanks! Also added tiny SDK snippet in guides/sdk-snippets.md showing `encodeURIComponent(anchor.toLowerCase())` for deep links.
